svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.9.5 Header Joists
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION

g.text: ARTICLES 9.23.9.5. AND 9.23.9.6. READ TOGETHER, BY HEADER JOIST LENGTH
Header joist length around the floor opening
more than 800 mm, up to 1.2 m
more than 1.2 m, up to 2 m
more than 2 m, up to 3.2 m

svg.text: Header joists around floor openings are
doubled when they exceed 1.2 m (3′-11¼″) in
The size of header joists exceeding 3.2 m
Drawn: header joists in yellow. Trimmers follow Article 9.23.9.6. In C the doubled members only mark the header, its size comes from calculations.
